text: We often rush to upgrade our tools or workflows to gain more efficiency, but when the calendar is already overflowing, a new upgrade becomes a hidden liability. Every transition requires a steep learning curve and significant mental bandwidth. If you don't have the breathing room to actually master a new system, you're just adding cognitive friction to an already overloaded plate
